explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/91: for large n, are there at least two non-similar n-point sets minimising the number of distinct distances? The statement asserts that UniqueMinimizer n fails eventually. IsOptimal A n means |A| = n and A attains the minimal number of distinct distances. Similarity is a DilationEquiv of ℝ² (bijective, uniformly scaling distances, reflections included), which is the standard notion. Faithful.
